category_macro_f1.rationale: Macro F1 over 9 categories with a 3-case confusion budget; 0.05 margin absorbs one additional per-label confusion.

extraction_precision.rationale: 40/41 predicted-knowledge threads were true knowledge; 0.05 margin allows roughly two extra false positives at this corpus size.

extraction_recall.rationale: 40/42 knowledge threads were extracted; 0.05 margin allows roughly two additional missed threads.

merge_pairwise_precision.rationale: 5/6 predicted merge pairs were correct over 6 expected pairs; the small pair count makes each error worth 0.17, so the floor sits one designed error below measurement.

merge_pairwise_recall.rationale: 5/6 expected merge pairs were recovered; same small-sample reasoning as merge precision.

scope_expected_file_match_rate.rationale: 78/80 scope checks matched; 0.05 margin allows two further failing checks.

scope_valid_glob_rate.rationale: All 40 predicted globs were valid; the structured output schema makes invalid globs rare, so only a 0.02 margin is granted.

search_mrr.rationale: Every query ranked a relevant thread first; 0.1 margin tolerates one query dropping its first relevant hit to rank two.

search_ndcg.rationale: One query ranked graded relevance out of order; 0.1 margin tolerates one additional swapped pair.

severity_weighted_accuracy.rationale: 89/98 weighted severity points with a 3-case error budget; 0.05 margin absorbs one further must-level miss.

update_procedure: Thresholds derive from the recorded fixture-replay baseline, not a live provider run. To replace them with live measurements, follow docs/operations/golden-baseline-runbook.md, re-review every metric, bump thresholds_version, and update the baseline binding.
